title: Company types to test — run the Sales tests once for each

steps.do: Profile A — Third-party inspection agency (services by man-day). Left menu → Admin → Settings → Your industry → "Inspection, testing & certification" → Make it the company's industry (tick "I understand the changes listed above.").
steps.expect: Wording and ISO/IEC 17020 rules match an inspection body.
steps.observed: Already the company's industry ("✓ Your company already uses this industry's wording and accreditation rules"); wording pack "inspection", accreditation rules "inspection" (ISO/IEC 17020).

steps.do: Profile B — Testing laboratory: "Testing & calibration laboratory".
steps.expect: The ISO/IEC 17025 laboratory rules are switched on, inspection rules off; the panel listed both changes before you confirmed.
steps.observed: The panel listed "17020 … turned OFF" and "17025 … turned ON" before confirming; after: "Your company's industry is now Testing & calibration laboratory. Quotation and order lines now also offer Per sample, Pe" — rules now "labs".

steps.do: Profile C — Manpower supply / deputation: "Recruitment & staffing". Quote by Man-month.
steps.expect: Man-month quotations need an approved project costing (if your Set up Sales answer says so).
steps.observed: Applied ("Your company's industry is now Recruitment & staffing. Quotation and order lines"). A man-month quotation (Q-00001) without a costing: "Not ready to submit: A man-month quote goes forward only from an approved project costing — make one for it (Project costing), have it approved, and link it to this quote."

steps.do: Profile D — Manufacturer selling products: "Manufacturing & engineering". Try to quote 50 cabinets.
steps.expect: Making it the company's industry says the quotation lines now also offer Nos, Set, Kg, Tonne and more. A new quotation line starts in Nos; the service units (Man-day …) are still there for service lines. There is still no HSN code field — record that as a GAP.
steps.observed: Applied: "Your company's industry is now Manufacturing & engineering. Quotation and order lines now also offer Nos, Set, Kg, Tonne and more. No accreditation rules are on". New line starts in Nos; units Man-day, Man-month, Per visit, Audit day, Per lot / lump sum, Per document, Per km, Other, Per sample, Per test, Per parameter, Per hour, Per month, Nos, Set, Kg, Tonne, Metre, Litre, Box, Pair. HSN code field: none (GAP, as the test expects).
steps.note: GAP recorded as the test asks: the quotation line has no HSN code field.

steps.expect: Lines offer Nos, Set, Box, Carton, Dozen, Kg, Tonne, Metre, Litre, Roll, Pair as well as the service units; a new line starts in Nos (owner, 12 Nov 2026).
steps.observed: A new line starts in Nos; offers Man-day, Man-month, Per visit, Audit day, Per lot / lump sum, Per document, Per km, Other, Per sample, Per test, Per parameter, Per hour, Per month, Nos, Set, Kg, Tonne, Metre, Litre, Box, Pair, Carton, Dozen, Roll.

steps.do: Profile F — Construction / EPC: "Construction, projects & infrastructure". Quote lump-sum stages.
steps.expect: Lines also offer "Per stage / milestone", square / cubic / running metre. The quotation page has "Billing by milestones" → "Set up milestones" (see SAL-158).
steps.observed: Lines offer Per parameter, Metre, Per stage / milestone, Square metre, Cubic metre, Running metre; the quotation page has "Billing by milestones" with "Set up milestones".

steps.do: Profile G — One-person consultancy: no approval levels at all; Set up Sales "No approval is needed".
steps.expect: Quotes can be sent straight from Draft.
steps.observed: Applied "Professional & consulting services"; levels removed — Set up Sales: "You have no approval levels yet…"; quotation Q-00003 is Draft and offers "Send to client" straight away ("No approval needed").
steps.note: There is no industry called "One-person consultancy"; the robot used "Professional & consulting services" and removed the approval levels.

steps.do: After each profile, go back to Profile A on the test workspace.
steps.observed: Back on Inspection: "Your company's industry is now Inspection, testing & certification. The inspection (ISO/IEC 17020) accreditation rules a"; wording pack "inspection" (Operations speaks of inspection calls), rules "inspection".
